title: Backtanked
description: A Modpack for the Backtank SMP
body:
This modpack is used for the **Backtanked SMP**, a community server centered around **economy**, **automation**, and **cooperation**.

> ### Key Features
> 1. Automate and set up factories with the help of the **Create Mod** (and many create add-ons)
> 2. With **Epic Terrain** + **YUNG's Better structures** you can enjoy beatiful landscapes and monuments.
> 3. Ascend to the skies with **Create: Aeronautics**
> 4. It's built with multiplayer in mind, including everything from Voice Chat to Land Claims


<details>
<summary>DISCLAIMER</summary>

This modpack does not include server-side mods.

</details>
